summary.text: Dennis Moss is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 29, having assumed office in 2008, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
He is retired from the South Carolina Highway Patrol, and the Republican primary for his seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Moss attended Spartanburg Methodist College and is retired from the South Carolina Highway Patrol, according to Ballotpedia.
He chaired the Invitations and Memorial Resolutions Committee in the 2023-2024 session and is assigned to that committee and to the Ways and Means Committee in the 2025-2026 session.
